commitMessage:
fix BucketTree.translateSegment for Integer.MIN_VALUE

Special case that unintuitive abs(Integer.MIN_VALUE) < 0, -1 % n < 0
summary: Wraps `Math.abs(expr) % divisor` with another `Math.abs()` to ensure a non-negative result, fixing potential `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` when `expr` evaluates to `Integer.MIN_VALUE`.

commitMessage:
Make AbstractDataTree.immutable field volatile

The write access is synchronized, but read access is not. Make sure
other threads see the right value immediately.

This most likely does not fix issue #200, but looks suspicious enough.

See https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/200
dslRule:
<!id: add.volatile.to.private.boolean.field.initialized.false>
<!description: Adds 'volatile' modifier to a private boolean field initialized to 'false', removing the redundant initialization as 'false' is the default for booleans. This improves visibility in multi-threaded contexts.
Requires manual review to confirm thread-safety implications.>
<!severity: WARNING>
private boolean $name = false;
=>
private volatile boolean $name;
;;
summary: Adds 'volatile' to private boolean fields initialized to false and removes the redundant initializer.

commitMessage:
Provide static acessors in the interface as an alternative to Platform

Currently one obtains ILog either by injection/di or a static call to
Platform.getLog(...)., but is is more semantic to only use ILog
interface and also decreases the coupling of the code to a central
singleton class.

Use equinox preferences APIs in AutoBuildJob class #497

Replace deprecated preferences APIs.
In the implementation of
IPreferenceChangeListener.preferenceChange(PreferenceChangeEvent) do not
use the newValue field of the PreferenceChangeEvent object because it is
null when autobuild is being turned on (this is caused by the method
Preferences.setValue(String, boolean) removing the explicit setting when
the value is equal to the default value).

Partially fixes
https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/497
summary: Replaces the deprecated `Preferences.addPropertyChangeListener()` method call with its equivalent using the Equinox Preferences API via `InstanceScope.INSTANCE.getNode(ResourcesPlugin.PI_RESOURCES).addPreferenceChangeListener()`.

commitMessage:
Fix CharsetManager#setCharsetForHasFailed

In case an error occurred when storing the preferences after setting a charset for the workspace, an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException could be thrown because the error message generation tried to extract the project segment out of the workspace path.
With this change, the generated error message becomes independent of the type of content of the given path.
summary: Cannot express a rule to replace `project.getFullPath()` with `resourcePath` where `project` is derived from `resourcePath.segment(0)` across statements due to lack of data-flow analysis.

commitMessage:
Throw exception when build job is waiting and JobManager is suspended

If a test suspends the JobManager and then waits for the build job to
finish then an exception will be thrown. The reason for this is that
waiting for a build job while the JobManager is not running is an
endless wait so the programmer should be informed.

Let the ResourceTest class restore the original state of the JobManager
in the tearDown method in order to minimize the chances that a test
throws such an exception just because the test did not clean up after
its execution (print a warning if the test did not clean up after
itself).

Contributes to
https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/626
summary: The commit introduces new statements, control flow, and a class definition, which are beyond the capabilities of the current TriggerPattern DSL.
